gerekce: The standalone disqualifier is unsupported valuation: a 38.92x earnings multiple, 1.39% parent-attributed free-cash-flow yield, and 30.89x lease-exclusive enterprise value to operating income are not supported by the reported operating profile. Revenue and operating income grew, but operating cash flow declined and current YTD free cash flow became negative. With no forward estimates in the report, there is insufficient evidence that future growth or cash generation can justify the current valuation.
